title: From Hollywood to Washington: The insane UFO encounters these celebs allegedly had
excerpt: Some popular and influential people had reportedly alleged that they encountered and experienced insane UFO activities connected to extraterrestrial presence. The American actress and writer Fran Drescher claimed that aliens might have abducted her during her teenage period.
content:
Rajarshi Deb

Updated Thu, September 10, 2026 at 4:56 PM UTC

Some popular and influential people had reportedly alleged that they encountered and experienced insane UFO activities connected to extraterrestrial presence. The American actress and writer Fran Drescher claimed that aliens might have abducted her during her teenage period. The songwriter and guitarist, Sammy Hagar, explained that he felt a direct mental link with extraterrestrials.

The actress Shirley MacLaine shared that she had spoken for decades about UFOs and visitors from other worlds. The popstar Demi Lovato also said that the encounter with an unidentified flying object made her believe that intelligent life exists beyond Earth. Former congressman Dennis Kucinich once described that he saw a large, silent, triangular flying object near MacLaine's home.

Some experiences have simple explanations while others stay unexplained. However, all of them show how seriously these celebrities and political figures consider the theory that humanity may not be alone.

Continue reading more about UFO stories.

Celebrities and their rumored UFO narratives

CBS News reported that Fran Drescher and her ex-husband, Peter, were abducted by aliens. Drescher claimed that both of them saw aliens before they even knew each other. She explained that they experienced the activities while they were driving on the road with their fathers.

During an interview with E! News, Demi Lovato claimed that she had a close encounter with extraterrestrial beings in Joshua Tree and described her extraordinary experience as mind-blowing. She recalled,

"We went out into the desert in Joshua Tree, and I basically saw this blue orb that was about 50 feet away, maybe less, and it was kind of like floating above the ground, just like 10 or 15 feet, and it was kind of keeping its distance from me."

According to the Guardian, former band member of Montrose, Sammy Hagar, claimed that extraterrestrials entered his consciousness while he was in the California foothills. His intergalactic theories became public through his Red: My Uncensored Life in Rock.

In the book, he recalled that he lay in bed one night and dreamt of a ship with two beings inside. Their faces were not visible. He believed that they were linked to his mind through a strange wireless connection.

Shirley MacLaine and Dennis Kucinich opened up about witnessing UFOs

Shirley MacLaine stated that her interest in UFOs began when she was 18 years old. As per Variety,she claimed to have seen a full squadron of unidentified flying objects flying above the White House and the U.S. Capitol building.

The actress also asserted that she had witnessed numerous out-of-the-world objects from her property and explained that these extraterrestrials are attracted to the area because of its strong presence of natural crystals.

On the other hand, Dennis Kucinich revealed that he saw an unidentified flying object outside MacLaine's home. He said,

"It was an unidentified flying object, OK? It’s, like, it’s unidentified. I saw something."

MacLaine was delighted that her close friend acknowledged seeing a UFO. She added that she hopes his admission will encourage the government to reveal the truth.
